title: Ideas through the week
description: Sketch lines and exact observation dots follow a numeric horizontal scale.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique nonempty observation IDs, labels, strictly increasing finite x coordinates and values keyed by series ID. Signed finite readings are supported. Null, missing and non-finite values break only their own series.

props.name: series
props.description: Unique nonempty series IDs, labels and optional categorical tones a–i.

props.name: xFormatter
props.description: Formats numeric X ticks, including caller-provided timestamps; defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement label; defaults to Value (Total for pie/donut, Observations for scatter).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats exact values in labels and tooltips; defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise uses responsive plot proportions. Dense content scrolls locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native Recharts motion subject to token timing and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.
